data_evidence.shift_location_note: Yes, dawn and afternoon trips start in different places. Dawn trips (start 04-06h, n=1250 of 3430 multi-bin trips) open in Rio Maior town: top first-stop cells 39.33719,-8.93518 (n=158) and 39.33451,-8.93167 (n=118), with 43.0% of first stops within 2 km of the Estaleiro Municipal (39.33921,-8.92493). Afternoon trips (start 14-15h, n=1944) most often open in the southern parishes: top cell 39.26219,-8.83352 (Sao Joao da Ribeira/Marmeleira area, n=142), then 39.25639,-8.89603 (n=84); only 25.9% start within 2 km of the estaleiro (median first-stop distance 6.1 km vs 4.9 km for dawn trips). This fits a single town-side depot with afternoon routes deadheading out to peripheral parishes before the first recorded container stop. Note stops are container locations only - the depot visit and the tipping leg are not themselves recorded, so first/last hot cells are depot-side hints, not the depot itself.

osm_facilities_note: Facility-scale hits only; 180+ street-level recycling/glass bank points (fclass recycling, recycling_glass, recycling_clothes) and 20+ village ETARs matched the keyword scan and were excluded as non-facilities. Landfill polygons near 39.38-39.39,-8.91/-8.92 (Alcobertas area) and 39.30-39.32 west of town are unnamed landuse=landfill features, likely old quarry/dump sites, not the active disposal point.

synthesis: The likely truck base is the Estaleiro Municipal (municipal fleet yard) at 39.3392,-8.9249 on the east side of Rio Maior town, about 0.9 km from the strongest first-stop hot cell (39.3372,-8.9352, n=260) and closest to where dawn trips open their routes. The likely disposal point is the co-located Valorsul Estacao de Transferencia / Ecocentro complex in the Zona Industrial south-east of town (approx. 39.317 to 39.320, -8.924 to -8.911), roughly 2.5 km from the estaleiro. Trips record only container stops, so the pattern - first stops clustering in town near the estaleiro at dawn, last stops scattered across peripheral parishes - is consistent with trucks leaving the town depot, collecting outward, and making an unrecorded tipping leg to the transfer station before returning.
